bugs.error_message: NOTAIO_BUNDLE_LIFETIME_SECONDS=15m silently used 3600; 0 or negative accepted
bugs.root_cause: env value parsed with .ok().and_then(parse().ok()).unwrap_or(default): no error path, no bounds
bugs.fix: cli::bundle_lifetime_seconds: 300..=86400, startup error naming the variable (ADR-0018)

bugs.error_message: per-policy metrics and NotaioBundleNearExpiry named namespace notaio-system
bugs.root_cause: PodMonitor without honorLabels: Prometheus overwrote notaio's namespace label with the target's and moved it to exported_namespace

bugs.error_message: NotaioBundleNearExpiry fired: bundle re-signed with 205 s of its lifetime left instead of half
bugs.root_cause: an unchanged reconcile requeued a fixed half-lifetime, regardless of when the bundle turns stale; a reconcile just before that point pushed the refresh to almost notAfter
bugs.fix: refresh::next_check: requeue at the earlier of the evaluator's requeue and the stale moment (+1 s)
